d9c8c68fc82b6e18.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة روابي القابضة عن مشرف مسكن للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان تطبيق اللوائح المنظمة للسكن وتوفير بيئة آمنة ومريحة للمقيمين، مع التركيز على متابعة الخدمات الأساسية والنظافة العامة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تطبيق والالتزام باللوائح التنظيمية والتعليمات المنظمة لأعمال السكن بشكل دوري. إعداد قاعدة بيانات شاملة بالساكنين ومتابعة تحديثها وتطويرها باستمرار. متابعة توفير الخدمات العامة الأساسية مثل الماء والكهرباء والاتصالات لضمان استمراريتها. الإشراف على النظافة العامة والشروط الصحية والسلامة العامة والأمن في السكن. توفير الخدمات الطبية الطارئة عند الحاجة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على متابعة وتطبيق اللوائح والتعليمات بدقة. مهارات تنظيمية جيدة لإدارة قواعد البيانات والتقارير. بيئة العمل يعمل مشرف المسكن بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة روابي القابضة في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية، ويساهم في توفير بيئة معيشية منظمة وآمنة للمقيمين. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة روابي القابضة.

d9e8220b5e4b416f.description: About the Role Premium Food Company is seeking a Hospitality Manager to lead the assessment and improvement of hospitality performance across its restaurant portfolio. This full-time role is based in Makkah and Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. The Hospitality Manager will work directly with Customer Experience and Operations leadership to identify guest-experience gaps and ensure sustainable improvement in service delivery. Key Responsibilities Conduct planned and unannounced restaurant visits to evaluate the complete dine-in journey and document evidence-based findings across brands, branches, dayparts, and peak periods. Utilize audits, guest feedback, complaints, NPS, reviews, and mystery shopper results to identify root causes, prioritize risks, agree on owners and deadlines, and verify sustained closure of issues. Provide hands-on coaching and practical training for managers, supervisors, hosts, cashiers, waiters, captains, and other frontline employees, demonstrating behaviors and confirming competence on the live floor. Equip Area and Restaurant Managers to brief, observe, recognize, correct, and follow up on hospitality performance every shift, escalating repeated gaps and recommending appropriate interventions. Translate approved hospitality standards into natural, observable behaviors suited to each brand level, avoiding robotic or scripted interactions. Improve preference discovery, menu storytelling, personalized recommendations, hospitality-led suggestive selling, attentiveness, and memorable guest experiences. Coach teams to recognize dissatisfaction, listen, empathize, apologize, take ownership, act within approved authority, escalate correctly, follow up, and confirm satisfaction. Partner with CX, Operations, and Training leaders, maintain concise performance reporting, track corrective actions, highlight systemic risks and best practices, and recommend continuous improvements. Decision-Making Authority Conduct announced and unannounced assessments and coach employees and managers directly during visits. Require corrective-action plans, agree on deadlines with Operations, and request retraining or reassessment. Escalate critical or repeated failures and recommend recognition, development, reassignment, or performance intervention. Contribute to decisions on hospitality standards, training, assessment, certification, and leadership capability. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in hospitality management or a related field. Demonstrated ability to assess performance, identify gaps, and implement corrective actions. Experience in coaching and training frontline employees and management. Work Location This position is based in the Makkah region, with responsibilities covering locations in Jeddah and Makkah. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this full-time role. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

d98c1d4d4c5881ec.description: About the Role The Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) is seeking a Lead Ethics Specialist to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah. This full-time role involves leading the development and implementation of proactive measures to uphold ethical standards and prevent misconduct within the Bank Group. The specialist will contribute significantly to the organization's learning and its transformation into a knowledge-based entity. Key Responsibilities Monitor and report on planned prevention activities and programs to ensure compliance with the Bank Group Code of Ethics. Handle complex, sensitive, and confidential assignments independently. Deliver ethics products and services to IsDB Group staff and provide oversight on the interpretation of the Code of Ethics and related policies. Support the Director in developing and executing communications, training, and education programs to inform staff of ethical obligations. Lead complex training and communications projects, including writing articles, giving presentations, and developing communication materials. Oversee the preparation of annual reports and other written products for the Department Director. Assist in keeping IsDB Group Units informed on relevant ethics issues and oversee data analysis to identify trends and major issues. Recommend and implement policies, procedures, and targeted programs for strategic use. Supervise consultants and oversee contracts as requested by the Director. Support activities related to allegations of staff misconduct and play a key role in reviewing and developing internal procedures and manuals. Mainstream ethics into Bank Group policy documents and engage departments on lessons learned. Organize and oversee training, capacity building, awareness-raising, and sensitization activities to enhance ethical conduct. Develop presentations and materials for the prevention of staff misconduct. Lead the launch and implementation of the Financial Disclosure and Conflict of Interests Program. Undertake staff misconduct investigations and prepare corresponding reports. Spearhead the identification and organization of collaborative partnerships with regional and international trainers for staff training programs. Knowledge Management Contributions Lead the organization and implementation of meetings, workshops, and video conferences to promote dialogue on integrity and ethics. Provide administrative and technical support on ethics issues during major events. Lead the preparation of a periodic newsletter on Ethics Prevention and Outreach Products. Prepare annual integrity and ethics reports and ensure their publication. Lead special initiatives/projects and undertake ad hoc assignments as required. Capacity Building and Advisory Functions Lead, organize, and oversee the implementation of training and awareness activities for staff misconduct prevention. Lead in designing and developing innovative training tools and modules based on data analysis to enhance staff expertise. Lead the implementation of a Training and Awareness Plan for staff capacity building and sensitization. Advise IsDB Group Staff on the provisions of the IsDB Group Code of Ethics. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience is required. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, within the Islamic Development Bank Group.

d9d462712c0b32e0.description: About the Role Delta Hotels and Resorts® is seeking a Laundry Attendant to join their team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves operating and monitoring laundry machinery to ensure the cleanliness and proper handling of all laundered items. The role is based in Makkah, with operations also extending to Jeddah. Key Responsibilities Operate and monitor washing, dry cleaning, and drying machinery, including adding necessary chemicals and cleaning lint traps. Identify stained or damaged items and determine appropriate action for repair, spot treatment, rewash, or discard. Inspect the cleanliness of articles removed from machines and place them into clean linen carts. Set dryers to designated times and temperatures based on fabric types. Remove lint and debris from dryer screens, dry cleaning filters, and drain traps after each load. Fold cleaned articles to designated sizes, either by hand or using a folding machine. Maintain accurate records of all laundered items. Adhere to all company safety and security policies and procedures, reporting accidents, injuries, and unsafe conditions to management. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, and maintain confidentiality of proprietary information. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues and support team goals. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards, and identify opportunities for efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, or cost-savings improvements. Physical Requirements Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods or an entire work shift. Capability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance. Maneuver through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Navigate sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces, as well as stairs and service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Qualifications and Experience No high school diploma or *** equivalent is required. No prior related work experience is necessary for this role. No supervisory experience is required. No specific license or certification is needed. Work Environment This is a full-time position within the hospitality industry, based in Makkah. The role requires adherence to established company policies and procedures, including safety training and certifications. The successful candidate will work as part of a team, contributing to the overall efficiency and quality of laundry operations.

d9db9413362872e1.description: About the Role NHC is seeking a Network Infrastructure Senior Engineer to join their team in Makkah, with work locations in Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves designing, developing, and overseeing the implementation of network infrastructure for large-scale residential community development projects. The successful candidate will ensure secure, reliable, and scalable connectivity in compliance with applicable standards and regulations. Key Responsibilities Design network infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, wireless, fiber optic, and structured cabling systems. Coordinate network infrastructure designs with civil, electrical, and other engineering disciplines to ensure seamless integration across development projects. Develop network diagrams, topology layouts, and technical documentation. Coordinate with engineering teams, contractors, and vendors to ensure successful network infrastructure deployment. Oversee network installation, testing, troubleshooting, and maintenance. Ensure compliance with telecommunications standards, cybersecurity requirements, and safety regulations. Prepare network infrastructure progress reports and provide technical support to project teams. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in engineering or an equivalent field. A minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in network infrastructure or a related field. Demonstrated knowledge of LAN, WAN, wireless networks, fiber optics, and structured cables. Experience in network infrastructure design, installation, and troubleshooting. Familiarity with telecommunications standards and cybersecurity requirements. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in the Makkah region, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves working on large-scale residential community development projects, collaborating with various engineering disciplines and external vendors. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

d9ea99f34cd25b18.description: About Unifonic Unifonic is an AI-native customer experience platform designed for emerging markets, recognized as a Great Place to Work®. The company is pioneering sovereign, agentic AI through its Agentic Studio platform, focusing on how it is perceived by buyers, analysts, media, and the broader market. This team comprises experts in account management, business development, and customer service, collaborating with other departments to ensure products and services meet customer needs. The team seeks individuals with a track record of success in sales, an aptitude for relationship building, and a commitment to customer support. This full-time role involves managing key accounts, understanding customer business objectives, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering value through Unifonic's solutions. The Key Account Manager will act as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, develop strategic account plans, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure customer success, retention, and revenue growth. This position requires 5-10 years of experience, exceptional relationship management skills, strategic thinking, and strong commercial acumen to achieve business objectives and maximize long-term customer value. Key Responsibilities Manage and grow a portfolio of enterprise customers. Develop trusted relationships with key stakeholders and executive sponsors. Create and execute strategic account plans. Identify opportunities for account expansion through additional products and services. Conduct regular business reviews and ensure customer satisfaction. Collaborate with Customer Success and other internal teams to maximize customer value. Maintain accurate account plans, forecasts, and CRM records. Identify opportunities to expand business within existing accounts. Build relationships with prospective enterprise customers through networking, referrals, and industry engagement. Lead commercial discussions and solution presentations. Prepare proposals, negotiate contracts, and support the sales process through deal closure. Contribute to achieving the team’s revenue and growth objectives. Required Character Traits Analytical thinking and problem-solving: Ability to approach problems clearly, use data, and find solutions. Ownership and accountability: Takes responsibility and follows projects through to completion. Communication: Explains ideas clearly and listens to others across teams. Collaboration: Works effectively with others and supports team goals. Adaptability and learning: Adjusts to change and continuously acquires new skills or tools. Mentorship and knowledge sharing: Supports the growth of others and shares expertise. Resilience: Maintains composure under pressure and handles setbacks constructively. Quality and attention to detail: Performs work carefully and strives for continuous improvement. Advocacy and innovation: Encourages best practices, efficiency, and new ideas.

d9575e8fa2d8e08c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الهيئة السعودية للمدن الصناعية ومناطق التقنية عن خبير حوكمة وامتثال البيانات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على حوكمة وإدارة البيانات وتطويرها بشكل مستمر، بالإضافة إلى مراقبة الامتثال للمعايير والسياسات المتعلقة بإدارة البيانات. الهدف الوظيفي يهدف شاغل هذه الوظيفة إلى ضمان تطبيق معايير وضوابط وسياسات إدارة البيانات، وجمع الأدلة الداعمة للامتثال، وبناء التقارير المتعلقة بذلك. كما يساهم في التطوير المستمر لعمليات حوكمة وإدارة البيانات داخل الهيئة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تطوير عمليات حوكمة وإدارة البيانات في الهيئة وضمان تنفيذ وتطبيق سياسات وإجراءات حوكمة البيانات. تطوير خطط مكتب إدارة البيانات لتنفيذ برامج إدارة وحوكمة البيانات، ومراقبة التقدم المحقق فيها والإبلاغ عن مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية الخاصة بها. إجراء المراجعات الدورية لسياسات وإجراءات حوكمة البيانات واقتراح التحسينات اللازمة. إجراء مراجعات داخلية على مستوى الإدارات للتأكد من مدى التزامها بسياسات ومعايير إدارة البيانات. إجراء تقييم مستوى النضج في محاور إدارة البيانات وفقًا لمواصفات ومتطلبات مكتب إدارة البيانات الوطنية ومؤشر نضيء، وتقديم التوصيات للرفع من مستوى النضج. إعداد التقارير الدورية لمستوى الامتثال، والتواصل مع الإدارات المعنية لجمع أدلة الامتثال الداعمة. إعداد سجلات المراجعات الدورية والإجراءات التصحيحية للامتثال ومتابعة تنفيذها. تحليل المخاطر المحتملة على إدارة البيانات، وبناء آلية ومنهجية لمعالجتها. دعم ومتابعة عمليات حصر مجموعات البيانات في سجل حصر البيانات، ومراجعة مستويات التصنيف لمجموعات البيانات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 6 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال حوكمة وامتثال البيانات. فهم عميق لمعايير وضوابط وسياسات إدارة البيانات. القدرة على تطوير وتنفيذ برامج حوكمة البيانات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق متخصص في الهيئة السعودية للمدن الصناعية ومناطق التقنية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، ولم يتم الإفصاح عنه علناً.

d99067db7c579883.description: About the Role Kempinski Hotels is seeking a Sales Manager to join their team in Al Khobar, Eastern region. This full-time position requires 5-10 years of experience and focuses on achieving hotel revenue targets by optimizing sales from an assigned account base and prospecting new clients in designated markets. The primary measure of performance will be against established revenue goals. Key Responsibilities Manage key accounts within an assigned base or geographic area to maximize revenue, achieve personal targets, and increase market share against competitors. Prospect and acquire new accounts. Oversee all segments of assigned geographical markets, which may include European markets. Conduct site inspections for potential clients. Adhere to Corporate Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Follow up on tentative bookings within assigned markets. Maintain detailed knowledge of the competitor set and all hotel services, facts, and figures. Ensure timely contracting with clients. Implement SMART contracting strategies for optimal yielding during annual rate negotiations. Attend trade shows, sales blitzes, and workshops in assigned markets. Assist the Director of Sales / Director of Sales & Marketing in defining and executing the annual sales action plan. Support the Director of Sales / Director of Sales & Marketing with annual budget preparation by providing account production statistics and forecasts. Execute sales actions within the allocated cost budget structure. Document all sales activities in SFA (S&C) and update the OPERA contact database regularly. Cross-sell other Kempinski Hotels. Understand and adhere to the Company Sales Vision. Participate in the Duty Manager rota. Strictly adhere to the Rules & Regulations in the Employees Handbook and the Hotel’s policy on Fire, Hygiene, Health & Safety. Report and rectify all potential and real hazards immediately. Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in sales, preferably within the hospitality sector. Demonstrated ability to achieve revenue targets and manage client accounts effectively. Proficiency in sales documentation systems such as SFA (S&C) and OPERA. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar, Eastern region, within a dynamic hotel environment. The role involves interaction with various departments and participation in a Duty Manager rota. Additional Information Additional responsibilities and tasks may be assigned as needed to support business operations and hotel requirements.

d99516e5154f9ed8.description: About the Role Fakeeh Care Group is seeking a Social Services Social Worker to join their team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves providing essential support to patients and their families, ensuring their needs are met during their visits or stay at Fakeeh Healthcare facilities. The position is open to candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to establish direct and indirect contact with patients, ensuring that Fakeeh Healthcare facility services meet their expectations and that patient complaints are addressed. The Social Services Social Worker assists and supports patients and their families through stressful and difficult situations, helping them find appropriate solutions during their time at the facility. Key Responsibilities Provide non-medical and non-nursing patient care and support. Coordinate Care Management services related to patient care. Offer administrative support, including obtaining medical reports in Arabic from the Medical Records Department. Address the social concerns of patients and conduct psychosocial assessments and counseling. Perform daily rounds for new admissions in Pediatric and Adult Oncology, BHU, regular rounds for long-stay patients (>7 days), and monthly rounds in RDU if applicable. Document relevant care in the EMR using the non-MD template. Provide follow-up services to appropriate patients and families. Participate in preparing treatment plans, especially for patients with psychosocial issues or at the end of life, requiring specific resources like family support, transport, or financial assistance. Collaborate with internal multidisciplinary teams, providers, allied health staff, patients, caregivers, and visitors. Participate in preparing discharge plans to facilitate patients' return home with optimal functioning conditions, if applicable. Respond to referrals for inpatients, outpatients (RDU, special needs, kidney transplant patients), and ER cases as per Fakeeh Care policy, if applicable. Actively participate in the End-of-Life Care team, supporting families through loss and grief situations (*, Code Mercy and Code Blue). Provide support to families of DNR (Do Not Resuscitate) patients. Assist patients with financial needs by preparing case studies and referring them to charity channels. Help patients and families obtain financial estimates for service prices when needed. Manage the DAMA (Discharge Against Medical Advice) process, track cases, contact patients who refuse admission or continuation of care, and prepare DAMA KPI reports with corrective action plans for HEC quarterly, if applicable. Provide special care for patients with specific needs, including the terminally ill, handicapped, victims of abuse or domestic violence, and those with non-psychiatric social problems. Coordinate the reporting process for abuse and domestic violence cases to MOH and HRSD, and report cases to the Violence and Abuse Protection Committee. Issue "Priority to Them" Cards and parking eligibility stickers for special needs patients per Fakeeh Care policy. Assist in arranging for clergy and interpreters for patients when needed. Coordinate with the Finance department to define financial coverage and limits. Attend committees and meetings as recommended. Arrange and attend family/physician meetings. Screen and support patients and families in ICU, CCU, NICU, and PICU, if applicable. Maintain and update a list of interpreters, clergy, and sign language experts. Accumulate and maintain information on community resources and programs to meet patient needs. For kidney transplant cases, conduct psychosocial evaluations, present data, address identified problems to the transplant committee, and educate patients regarding post-transplant expectations, including medication and insurance coverage, if applicable. Perform other duties as assigned within the scope of the job. Experience and Work Type This is a full-time position requiring 0-1 years of relevant experience. The role focuses on direct patient interaction and coordination within a healthcare setting. Location The role is based in the Makkah region, with responsibilities covering facilities in Jeddah and Makkah. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be disclosed during the interview process.

d984bf19af13cde5.description: About the Role Alpin is seeking an experienced Land Surveyor to support major infrastructure and urban development projects in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves planning, executing, and coordinating various surveying activities to ensure the accuracy and traceability of survey information for design and construction phases. Key Responsibilities Plan and conduct land, topographic, route, and construction surveys across project sites. Establish and maintain survey control points, benchmarks, and reference systems essential for project delivery. Perform setting-out, alignment, levelling, and as-built surveys, and verify the accuracy of completed works. Collect, process, and validate field survey data using appropriate equipment and digital workflows. Review survey information against drawings, models, and project requirements, identifying discrepancies and coordinating corrective actions. Review and validate survey data and deliverables prepared by third-party surveyors. Prepare and maintain survey records, field notes, drawings, reports, and as-built information in a controlled and auditable manner. Coordinate surveying activities and outputs with engineering, design, BIM/GIS, and construction teams, supporting the planning of additional site surveys and investigations as needed. Lead and coordinate survey teams, promoting safe working practices and consistent survey quality. Support specialist survey activities such as cadastral mapping, 3D scanning, or point-cloud data processing when required by the project. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 15 years of professional experience in land surveying, including major infrastructure and construction projects. Bachelor’s degree in Surveying, Geomatics Engineering, or a closely related discipline, OR a Master of Engineering (MEng) in Geomatics Engineering. Strong practical experience in setting-out, alignment, levelling, topographic surveys, and as-built verification. Demonstrated ability to coordinate survey teams and manage survey information across multidisciplinary projects. Relevant professional certification or membership is preferred. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, focusing on large-scale infrastructure and urban development projects. The role requires collaboration with various engineering and construction teams. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

d94eb9b2d8123965.description: About the Role BIG Academy is seeking qualified and experienced Faculty members specializing in Business, Accounting, and Finance to join its academic team in Riyadh. This full-time position requires 3-5 years of relevant experience. The role focuses on delivering engaging, practical, and industry-oriented teaching across various business disciplines. Additionally, this role involves contributing to curriculum development and maintaining academic quality standards within the institution. Explain business, accounting, and financial concepts using practical examples, industry applications, and case-based learning. Strong subject knowledge in Business Management, Accounting, Finance, and related disciplines. Ability to deliver engaging, practical, and industry-oriented teaching. d937ea2df10d1cca.description: About the Role GDC Middle East is seeking a Production Control Specialist to join their team in Dammam, Eastern Province. This full-time role is responsible for supporting aviation maintenance production control activities by planning, coordinating, scheduling, and monitoring maintenance operations. The specialist ensures aircraft maintenance requirements are executed efficiently, resources are utilized effectively, and aircraft are maintained in a safe and mission-ready condition. Role Context and Objectives The Production Control Specialist works closely with maintenance, logistics, supply, quality control, and safety personnel. d973f807c528fd28.description: About the role As the Senior Marketing Analyst for CRM, you will be the single analytics owner of CRM - the person marketers come to as a partner. You will own how campaigns are measured, how the communication data is built and trusted, and how insights turn into decisions: what to stop, scale, or fix. You will work closely with CRM marketers, Product, and the data platform team. You define what data you need and accept its quality; you do not build the pipelines yourself. Be the analytics partner to CRM marketers and Product on every initiative. Work with them on how to improve results. d97459b55a954243.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة جاز العربية للخدمات عن مهندس إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على وضع وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع المتكاملة، وإدارة التغييرات، وتحديد نطاق المشروع بدقة لضمان إنجاز المهام في الأوقات المحددة والميزانيات المخصصة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع وتنفيذ خطة متكاملة للمشروع، والتحكم في التغييرات، وتحديد نطاق المشروع بدقة من حيث البنود والأزمنة، مع فهم الجوانب الفنية لتنفيذ العمل. تقدير الأوقات والمواعيد النهائية للمشروع، وإعداد الجداول الزمنية باستخدام البرامج والتطبيقات المخصصة، مع تحديد المهام المجدولة وفترات تنفيذها والموارد المتاحة. إدارة التكلفة والموارد المطلوبة لإنجاز المشروع، بما في ذلك تخطيط وإدارة الموارد البشرية والمادية والمعدات والتقنيين، وتقدير التكلفة المتوقعة بالتعاون مع مهندسي التكاليف ومتابعة الإنفاق. إعداد وتطبيق خطة علاقات مع جميع الأطراف ذات الصلة بالمشروع، وتوفير أساس لتوزيع المعلومات ونشر حالة مراحل المشروع. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال إدارة المشاريع أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على استخدام برامج وتطبيقات إعداد الجداول الزمنية للمشاريع. فهم جيد للجوانب الفنية المتعلقة بتنفيذ المشاريع. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم. القدرة على إدارة التكاليف والموارد بفعالية. مهارات تواصل قوية لإدارة العلاقات مع الأطراف المعنية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل المهندس ضمن فريق متخصص في إدارة المشاريع، وستتاح له الفرصة للمساهمة في مشاريع متنوعة ضمن شركة جاز العربية للخدمات. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة جاز العربية للخدمات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

d9055ebcba8d2207.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة موضي الدهيش للتطوير والاستثمار العقاري عن مسوق عقاري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تعزيز التواجد في السوق العقاري، وجذب العملاء المحتملين، وإدارة علاقات الملاك والمستأجرين، والمساهمة في إتمام الصفقات العقارية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الخطط التسويقية المعتمدة لترويج العقارات المتاحة للبيع أو التأجير. استقبال استفسارات العملاء والرد عليها باحترافية، وترتيب مواعيد زيارة العقارات. إجراء عمليات المعاينة للعقارات وعرض المزايا والخصائص للعملاء بشكل مقنع. تحديث قواعد بيانات العقارات باستمرار وضمان دقة المعلومات المنشورة على المنصات الرقمية. بناء شبكة علاقات قوية مع المستثمرين والملاك لتعزيز فرص التعاون المستقبلية. إعداد تقارير دورية حول حركة السوق وأداء المبيعات والتأجير. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التسويق العقاري. القدرة على جذب العملاء المحتملين وإدارة العلاقات مع الملاك والمستأجرين. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق لتحقيق أهداف الشركة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق يسعى لتعزيز تواجد الشركة في السوق العقاري. يتوقع من شاغل الوظيفة المساهمة في تحقيق أهداف الشركة وتطلعات العملاء. نطاق الراتب يتراوح الراتب الشهري لهذا الدور بين 3,750 ريال سعودي و 5,625 ريال سعودي. التقديم ندعو الأفراد الطموحين والمتحمسين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

d9eb6059bdb95119.description: Job description About the job Diamond Drillers Job Title: Diamond Driller Department: APC Mining Section: Exploration – Mining & Geotechnical Drilling Reporting To: Operations Supervisor Job Purpose: Responsible for the safe operation and maintenance of diamond core drilling rigs, achieving high core recovery, maintaining accurate drilling records, and guiding work crews at the site. Apply knowledge of drilling fluids, downhole tools, and core handling techniques. Operate drilling equipment according to project specifications and achieve target depths and core recovery. Label, store, and protect core samples to maintain their quality and integrity. Record drilling depth, core recovery percentages, and lithological observations accurately. Strong knowledge of drilling fluids, downhole tools, and sampling techniques. Ability to work in remote locations under rotation schedules. Basic English reading and writing skills for following instructions and completing technical reports. Strong commitment to safety, accuracy, and professionalism. Required Skills: Strong teamwork and communication skills. Problem-solving abilities. Physical fitness to handle demanding field conditions. Ability to adapt to remote locations, rotation schedules, and extended working hours. Positive work attitude and accountability. Working Conditions: High-exposure working environment. High level of physical or mental injury risk. Must comply with site safety regulations and client defensive driving requirements, including relevant training. d97dc85b20104169.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة القسي العالمية للمقاولات عن فني هندسة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية والإشراف عليها ومراقبتها، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الدعم للمهندسين الكهربائيين في حل المشكلات الفنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد المخطط وتقدير كمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الأولية للمشاريع. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والفنيين والحرفيين الآخرين فيما يتعلق بأعمال تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية. اختبار الأنظمة الكهربائية بعد تركيبها لضمان التزامها بالمخطط الأولي والمواصفات الفنية المطلوبة. إجراء عمليات الفحص الروتينية كجزء من الصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. التحقق من الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات المعطوبة، وتشخيص المكونات التالفة وإصلاحها أو استبدالها. ضمان الاستجابة السريعة لعمليات الطوارئ للتقليل من فترات انقطاع التيار الكهربائي. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الكهربائية والمواصفات الفنية. مهارات قوية في تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية وإصلاحها. متطلبات العمل الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتقديم الدعم الفني. الاستعداد للتعامل مع حالات الطوارئ الكهربائية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. تتطلب بيئة العمل المرونة والاستعداد للتعامل مع مهام التركيب والصيانة في مواقع مختلفة. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق شركة القسي العالمية للمقاولات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لتحديد الخطوات التالية.
